Load current comes from an IREF-independent diode+R mirror. A resistor divider sets the cascode gate. M1 W is solved with the LUT forward model so Id1(0.75 V)=Iload. A trim term absorbs residual offset. Budget: about 15 + 3 + 1 µA core plus IREF, roughly 52 µW."}

PARAMS = {
    "I1":     (15e-6, 8e-6, 22e-6),   # signal-branch current
    "L1":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # input NMOS length
    "Lp":     (3.0, 1.5, 5.0),        # PMOS load/mirror length (sets ro2 -> gain)
    "gmid_p": (9.0, 6.0, 13.0),       # PMOS load gm/Id
    "gmid_c": (12.0, 8.0, 18.0),      # NMOS cascode gm/Id
    "Lc":     (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),        # cascode length
    "vds1":   (0.30, 0.20, 0.45),     # VDS of input device (cascode headroom)
    "kmir":   (5.0, 3.0, 8.0),        # PMOS mirror ratio I1/I4
    "trim":   (1.0, 0.93, 1.07),      # fine trim of M1 width -> output DC centring
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vo = 0.9                                   # target output DC (mid-rail)

    I1, k = p["I1"], p["kmir"]
    I4 = I1 / k

    # --- PMOS bias diode M4 (IREF-independent: diode + resistor to vss)
    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I4, vds=0.9)
    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I4, vds=m4.vgs)   # diode: vds = vsg
    vsg = m4.vgs
    W4 = m4.W
    R4 = (vdd - vsg) / I4

    # --- PMOS load M2 = exact k-scaled copy of M4, evaluated at its real VDS
    W2 = W4 * k
    o2 = lut.op("p", W2, p["Lp"], vsg, vdd - vo)
    I2 = o2["Id"]

    # --- NMOS cascode
    mc = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], p["Lc"], I2, vds=vo - p["vds1"], vsb=p["vds1"])
    vbn = p["vds1"] + mc.vgs

    # --- input NMOS: width solved so Id(vgs=VIN_DC, vds1) == I2
    ou = lut.op("n", 1.0, p["L1"], vin, p["vds1"])
    W1 = max(0.42, I2 / ou["Id"] * p["trim"])
    o1 = lut.op("n", W1, p["L1"], vin, p["vds1"])

    # --- cascode gate divider (~1 uA)
    Rtot = 1.8e6
    Rbot = vbn / vdd * Rtot
    Rtop = Rtot - Rbot

    # --- IREF sink (port must carry IREF)
    mb = lut.size("n", 8, 1.0, iref, vds=0.8)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("M1", "x", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W1, p["L1"])
    n.dev("MC", "vout", "vbn", "x", "vss", mc)
    n.M("M2", "vout", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W2, p["Lp"])
    n.M("M4", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W4, p["Lp"])
    n.R("R4", "pb", "vss", R4)
    n.R("RT", "vdd", "vbn", Rtop)
    n.R("RB", "vbn", "vss", Rbot)
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)

    # --- predictions
    gm1, gds1 = o1["gm"], o1["gds"]
    gmc = mc.gm + mc.gmbs
    Rn = (1.0 / mc.gds) * (1.0 + gmc / gds1) + 1.0 / gds1
    Rp = 1.0 / o2["gds"]
    Rout = Rn * Rp / (Rn + Rp)
    A = gm1 * Rout
    cout = cl + m4.cdd * k + mc.cdd
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cout)
    f3db = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rout * cout)
    vhi = vdd - o2.get("vdsat", 0.15) - 0.05
    vlo = p["vds1"] + mc.vdsat + 0.05
    power = vdd * (iref + I2 + I4 + vdd / Rtot)

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(A),
        "f3db": f3db,
        "gbw": gbw,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vo,
        "swing": vhi - vlo,
    }
